summary: EARTH Thunder 'scavengers.' Members activate straight from your hand to destroy a card, then swarm the board and loot the wreckage for more resources. Aggressive, hand-trap-resistant, and built to punish opponents who activate monster effects into it. Note the shared lock: after a Blitzclique hand effect resolves, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters except from the hand for the rest of the turn.

cards.name: Whisker Blitzclique
cards.effectText: During the turn a card(s) was destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card effect (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon up to 3 Thunder monsters from your hand, then you can destroy up to that many cards on the field, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. When a monster effect is activated, except in the hand (Quick Effect): You can return 1 other Thunder monster you control to the hand; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster. You can only use each effect of "Whisker Blitzclique" once per turn.

cards.name: Emi Blitzclique
cards.effectText: If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can reveal this card, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If another card(s) is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Blitzclique" Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Emi Blitzclique" once per turn.

cards.name: Surge Blitzclique
cards.effectText: You can reveal this card in your hand, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If another card(s) is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Blitzclique" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Surge Blitzclique". You can only use each effect of "Surge Blitzclique" once per turn.

cards.name: Crackle Blitzclique
cards.effectText: During your opponent's turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; destroy that monster, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If another card(s) is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can send 1 "Blitzclique" Spell/Trap from your Deck to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Crackle Blitzclique" once per turn.

cards.name: Grain Blitzclique
cards.effectText: You can reveal this card in your hand, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If another card(s) is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Blitzclique" Spell or 1 "Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Grain Blitzclique" once per turn.

cards.name: Blitzclique - Breakaway
cards.effectText: Activate 1 of these effects; ● Place 1 "Blitzclique" Continuous Trap from your Deck, face-up on your field. ● Return 1 Thunder monster you control to the hand, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it. If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Blitzclique - Breakaway" once per turn.

cards.name: Blitzclique - Steppleader
cards.effectText: If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Thunder monster in your GY; add it to your hand. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, then destroy this card. If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Blitzclique - Steppleader" once per turn.

cards.name: Blitzclique Return Stroke
cards.effectText: "Blitzclique" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Blitzclique Return Stroke" once per turn. When your opponent activates a Spell Card or effect: You can return 1 "Blitzclique" monster you control to the hand; negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Blitzclique" monster in your field or GY; return it to the hand.

cards.name: Blitzclique Alternator
cards.effectText: Monsters your opponent controls lose 300 ATK/DEF for each Thunder monster you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "Blitzclique Alternator" once per turn. You can shuffle 1 other "Blitzclique" card from your hand or face-up field into the Deck; add 1 Thunder monster with a different name from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Blitzclique" Spell or "Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb" from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb
cards.effectText: Monsters you control that were Normal or Special Summoned from the hand gain 500 ATK/DEF. You can only use each of the following effects of "Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "Mech Beast Token" (Machine/EARTH/Level 6/ATK 2000/DEF 2000) to your opponent's field, and if you do, add 1 "Blitzclique" monster from your Deck to your hand. If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand.

comboLines.title: Turn 1 Breakaway loot loop
comboLines.body: Open Blitzclique - Breakaway to place Blitzclique Return Stroke face-up from the Deck. Reveal Surge Blitzclique from hand to destroy a monster and Special Summon a Thunder monster; every on-field Blitzclique that watched the destruction loots (Surge searches a monster, Emi searches a Trap, Grain fetches a Spell or the Field Spell, Crackle stocks the GY). Because a Blitzclique effect destroyed a card this turn, you can now reveal Whisker Blitzclique (Quick Effect) to swarm up to 3 Thunder monsters from hand and destroy up to that many cards. Mind the lock — after any of these hand effects you can only Special Summon Effect Monsters from the hand for the rest of the turn, so lead with your Extra Deck plays if you need them.
